changeSet.sql:
WITH visualization_root AS ( SELECT id FROM portal_menu WHERE deleted = false AND parent_id IS NULL AND ( name = 'sys.nav.portal.visualization' OR path = 'visualization' OR metadata ILIKE '%"sectionKey":"visualization"%' ) ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1 ), targets AS ( SELECT m.id FROM portal_menu m JOIN visualization_root r ON m.parent_id = r.id WHERE m.deleted = false AND ( m.name = 'sys.nav.portal.visualizationWorkbench' OR m.path = 'workbench' OR m.metadata ILIKE '%"entryKey":"workbench"%' OR m.metadata ILIKE '%"titleKey":"sys.nav.portal.visualizationWorkbench"%' ) ) UPDATE portal_menu SET deleted = true WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM targets);
DELETE FROM portal_menu_visibility v WHERE v.menu_id IN ( SELECT m.id FROM portal_menu m JOIN portal_menu p ON m.parent_id = p.id WHERE p.parent_id IS NULL AND ( p.name = 'sys.nav.portal.visualization' OR p.path = 'visualization' OR p.metadata ILIKE '%"sectionKey":"visualization"%' ) AND ( m.name = 'sys.nav.portal.visualizationWorkbench' OR m.path = 'workbench' OR m.metadata ILIKE '%"entryKey":"workbench"%' OR m.metadata ILIKE '%"titleKey":"sys.nav.portal.visualizationWorkbench"%' ) );
